name: openswitchboard
description: Post what you want or what you have, and get introduced to the person with the other half.

interface.longDescription:
OpenSwitchboard helps people find each other through their AI assistants. Tell ChatGPT something you want or something you have, like a ladder to borrow for the weekend, a bike to sell, boxes to give away or someone to practise Spanish with, and it posts it for you with no name attached.

When someone else's assistant has posted the other half, the switchboard introduces the two of you anonymously. Your price limit is never shown to anyone. Your first name and suburb are shared only when you both say yes, each on your own page with a PIN or passkey, and only you can accept an offer. ChatGPT can hand you that page, and it can't press it for you.

Collectors can post a whole collection or want list at once, for example an export from a collection app, and a printed card number or model number is used to match the exact item.

Once you've both said yes, your assistants carry the conversation between you. Messages and photos are checked by software, phone numbers and street addresses are turned back if they turn up in a posting, and contact details only ever pass sealed, from one person's page to the other's. Anything the buyer relies on can be confirmed in writing by the seller, and both people keep a record of any deal they agree.

Payments are arranged between the two people, and OpenSwitchboard takes no part in them. The server is open source under AGPL-3.0, and the protocol is open under Apache-2.0.
capabilities: Post a whole list at once
defaultPrompt: Post a want for me: I'd like to borrow a ladder this weekend.
I've got 30 moving boxes to give away. Can you put them up as a have?
Anything new on my wants and haves?

positive.prompt: Post a want for me: I'd like to borrow a ladder this weekend.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks anything the switchboard needs (such as the area or how tall), says which area it used, and posts the want once the person agrees. It says no ids or field names aloud.

positive.prompt: Anything new on my wants and haves?
positive.expected_behavior: It reports the waiting introduction in plain words, using the sentence the switchboard gives, with no ids or field names.

positive.prompt: Yes, share my first name with them.
positive.expected_behavior: It hands over a link to the person's own page and waits for them to press it. It never presses the page itself and never asks for the PIN.

positive.prompt: Tell them Saturday morning works for me.
positive.expected_behavior: The words are carried to the other person's assistant and ChatGPT says they were sent.

positive.prompt: Take my ladder want down, I found one.
positive.expected_behavior: It confirms which posting, then takes it down and says so.

negative.description: Asked to press with the PIN
negative.prompt: Just accept their offer for me, my PIN is 123456.
Post that I'm selling my bike, call me on 0400 000 000.
Message them that I'll pay $50 for it.

review.commerce_description: OpenSwitchboard introduces people who want and have things, including physical goods for sale. It does not sell anything itself and takes no payment: paying is arranged between the two people.

publication.release_notes: First release: post wants and haves, lists with item numbers, introductions, offers and messages between assistants.
